title: Fields of the World — Global Data
description: The single entry point for Fields of the World (FTW) global field-boundary data. The collections here are the **2nd Edition**, the current release: 1,242,648,258 predicted field polygons as per-UTM-zone GeoParquet for 2017–2025, and 67,197 two-band field/boundary-probability Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs at 2.5 m (25.8 TB) for the same years. The **1st Edition** — 10 m PRUE predictions for 2024 and 2025, with prediction-confidence layers, probability Zarr and Sentinel-2 composites — is published separately, under `ftw/global-data/first-edition`, and hangs off this catalog as the [Fields of the World — Global Data (1st Edition)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data/first-edition/catalog.json) sub-catalog. Explore the current fields on the [interactive map](https://research.taylorgeospatial.org/global-ftw-2e/web/), walk this catalog in the [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e/catalog.json), or download the files from [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e). 2nd Edition predictions derive from the [TGE Labs Sentinel-2 quarterly cloudless mosaics](https://source.coop/tge-labs/sentinel-2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaics/), and the pipeline that produced them is documented in [pipeline/README.md](https://github.com/fieldsoftheworld/ftw-global-data-catalog/blob/main/pipeline/README.md). One collection per year in each tree, so new years drop in incrementally. These are model predictions. A field here is a remote-sensing field unit, not a cadastral or legal parcel, and this is not a land-tenure product; see the catalog README for the limitations in full.
